items.note: Prompt says the question is whether the July Pro price increase (49 to 69 USD) drove Pro churn, and that this is the focus rather than general churn by plan and cohort.
Prompt says to exclude every row where is_trial = yes.
Prompt says to exclude every row whose email ends in @ourco.test, calling them internal test accounts.
Prompt says an account has churned if it has a cancel_month.
Prompt says the answer goes to the CEO, and the summary bullets are addressed to the CEO.
Prompt asks for a summary of at most 5 bullets.
Prompt asks for one suggested chart, described in words only, and says not to produce a table, notebook, or code.
Prompt requires one bullet that states confidence in the conclusion and why, given the small sample.
